pack.name: DonutStudio Demo Visualizers
pack.author: DonutStudio
pack.description: Eight selected first-party visualizers for abstract backgrounds, musical score views and 3D scenes.

shaders.name: Plasma
shaders.description: A flowing spectrum field: bass expands its cells, mids bend hue, treble writes fine ripples, and onsets flash intersections. scale/speed/hueShift/brightness remain editable INPUTS.

shaders.name: Warp Tunnel
shaders.description: An endless ribbed tunnel that flies forward and flashes on the beat; the mix nudges the throttle. speed/twist/ribs and the two colours are INPUTS.

shaders.name: Kaleido
shaders.description: A mirror-kaleidoscope of a drifting field. Route a kick to 'segments' and a bassline to 'zoom' through the mod matrix to make it move with the music.

shaders.name: Neon Piano Roll
shaders.description: Falling score notes strike a keyboard with track-aware neon color, exact-frequency positioning, impact glow, and sparks.

shaders.name: Pitch Ribbons
shaders.description: Past and upcoming score notes become crisp horizontal voice-leading ribbons with exact-frequency pitch placement, harmonic-master connections, and transient punch.

shaders.name: Resonant Strings
shaders.description: Sounding pitch classes become vibrating ratio strings. With four root cycles, exact 5/4, 3/2, and 7/4 notes draw five, six, and seven spatial cycles, while frame-timed trails show their motion.

shaders.name: Resonance Ocean
shaders.description: A raymarched ocean where each note drives a wave train at its exact root-relative ratio: consonance locks into glassy interference patterns, dissonance whitens the water with foam. Bass burns the horizon.

shaders.name: Beat Reactor
shaders.description: A kinetic containment atom around a volatile plasma core. The camera orbits continuously while three field rings precess at independent audio-driven rates, bright electron carriages race around them, and every transient kicks the mechanism out of phase.
